nodes.title: The Dark Forest
nodes.text: You awaken in a dark forest. Ancient trees tower above you. A path splits in two directions.

choices.text: Take the left path (toward the light)
Take the right path (into the darkness)

nodes.title: Searching the Area
nodes.text: You find a sturdy stick and a worn map. The map shows a castle to the north and a village to the east.

nodes.title: The Sunlit Glade
nodes.text: A beautiful glade opens up. Wildflowers bloom everywhere. An old hermit sits by a fire.

nodes.title: The Hermit's Advice
nodes.text: The hermit peers at you. 'Seeking the crystal? It lies in the Dragon's Keep, past the bridge. Take this charm.' He hands you a glowing charm.

nodes.title: The Cave Entrance
nodes.text: A dark cave mouth yawns before you. Strange sounds echo from within. Bones litter the ground.

nodes.title: Among the Bones
nodes.text: You find a rusty sword among the bones. It still has some edge left.

choices.text: Take the sword and enter the cave

nodes.title: Inside the Cave
nodes.text: The cave is damp and cold. You hear dripping water. Two tunnels branch off.

nodes.title: Underground Lake
nodes.text: A vast underground lake stretches before you. The water glows faintly blue. A small boat floats at the edge.

nodes.title: Enchanted Waters
nodes.text: The water tastes sweet. You feel stronger and more perceptive. You notice a hidden passage.

nodes.title: The Treasure Room
nodes.text: Piles of gold and gems fill the room. But a stone guardian blocks the exit. It has a riddle carved on it.

nodes.title: Treasure Claimed
nodes.text: You solve the riddle! 'What has keys but no locks?' — A keyboard! The guardian steps aside. You grab a golden amulet.

nodes.title: Guardian Attacks
nodes.text: The guardian comes to life! Without the right answer, you must flee. You barely escape with your life.

nodes.title: The Crystal Cave
nodes.text: Crystals of every color light up the walls. In the center, a pedestal holds a brilliant crystal.

nodes.title: The River Bridge
nodes.text: A rickety bridge spans a rushing river. On the other side, you see the Dragon's Keep. A troll guards the bridge.

nodes.title: Battle with the Troll
nodes.text: The troll is massive! You fight bravely.

nodes.title: Crossing the River
nodes.text: The current is strong! You barely make it across, soaking wet but alive.

nodes.title: The Village
nodes.text: A small village. Villagers eye you suspiciously. The innkeeper waves you over.

nodes.title: The Innkeeper's Tale
nodes.text: 'Ah, an adventurer! The dragon stole our village's sacred gem. Slay the dragon and you'll be a hero. Here, take this shield.'

nodes.title: The Blacksmith
nodes.text: 'I can forge you a proper weapon, but I need steel. Bring me steel from the castle armory.'

choices.text: Head to the Dragon's Keep anyway

nodes.title: The Castle Gate
nodes.text: The castle gates are locked. A guard demands a password.

nodes.title: Climbing the Wall
nodes.text: You climb the crumbling wall and drop into the courtyard. You find the armory!

nodes.title: Inside the Castle
nodes.text: The castle is magnificent. Portraits line the halls. You find a hidden room with a magical sword!

nodes.title: The Dragon's Keep
nodes.text: A massive dragon blocks the entrance to a treasure chamber. Its eyes glow red.

choices.text: Fight the dragon with magic sword

nodes.title: Sneaking Past
nodes.text: The dragon spots you immediately! You barely escape with your life.

nodes.title: Ending: The Hero
nodes.text: You slay the dragon with the rusty sword! The villagers celebrate your return. You are named the Hero of the Forest. THE END

nodes.title: Ending: Legendary Warrior
nodes.text: The magical sword cuts through dragon scales like butter. You become a legendary warrior, your name sung in taverns for generations. THE END

nodes.title: Ending: The Peacemaker
nodes.text: The charm soothes the dragon. It becomes your guardian, and you live together in the Keep as friends. THE END

nodes.title: Ending: Crystal Sorcerer
nodes.text: The crystal's power forces the dragon to submit. You claim the dragon's hoard and become a powerful sorcerer. THE END

nodes.title: Ending: The Diplomat
nodes.text: The dragon accepts the amulet as tribute. It grants you three wishes. You wish for peace, wisdom, and adventure. THE END

nodes.title: Ending: The Crystal Bearer
nodes.text: You take the crystal. Its power protects you forever. You become the Crystal Bearer, guardian of the underground realm. THE END
